checks.message: Provisional geometry is visibly disclosed and tied to a full recalculation trigger.
All three key areas remain provisional constraints and are not described as official polygons.
Base land-use topology remains recomputable from the submitted site geometry.
No route, altitude, operator, device, or flight is claimed as authorized or running.
Twelve synthetic tasks reproduce accept, hold, reject, and ground-transfer branches with complete audit fields.
Authorization, operation, emergency command, privacy, public budget changes, and final veto remain human responsibilities.
Chinese and English proposals, figures, HTML exhibits, and drawings are paired.
Static offline HTML uses only embedded data, local assets, and local interaction.
Human-readable claims connect to source, standard, depth, geometry, metric, risk, and simulation evidence.
